question: What can and cannot be declined among ordinary card or board effects, an arrow cost, a black-X trash icon, self-trashing instructions and Intrigue play? Can you repeat a paid arrow effect by paying twice?
key: Ordinary mandatory unless may,arrow payment optional except Intrigue must pay;blackX trash optional except cost;self-trash directive without arrow mandatory;arrow effect only once,not pay twice.

observed.answer: Most board/card effects are mandatory unless they say ‘may,’ use an optional arrow, or optional black-X trash icon; ordinary optional arrow payment/effect may be declined. Board entry costs must be paid, and Intrigue costs/conditions must be met. A non-arrow instruction to trash the card itself is mandatory. An optional arrow effect can be paid and resolved only once, not repeated by paying again.
observed.evidence: Agent turn rules on mandatory effects, arrows, trash icons, entry costs and Intrigue conditions.

An ordinary card’s optional arrow payment/effect may be declined, but a board entry cost must be paid to enter, and Intrigue costs/conditions must be met to play. An optional arrow effect can be paid and resolved only once, not repeated by paying again.
